project.name: OpenScreen
project.one_liner: Free, open-source Screen Studio alternative with auto-zoom, motion blur, smooth cursor, no watermarks.

panels.composition: vertical crop of real app/demo output, big caption says 'This is free?'

panels.beat: OpenScreen is a free open-source Screen Studio alternative

panels.motion_intent: slow scroll, cursor circles project description, highlight box fades in
